# What haruspex models

<!-- Generated by CoveragePageTests. Don't edit this file: tests/coverage/README.md says how to rewrite it. -->

Every built-in function SQL Server 2025 documents, and every statement, clause, table source, expression and operator its
parser reads, with what haruspex does with each: how a result is typed and when it may be NULL, or the unknown it gives
instead. A test writes this page from the code, so it says what haruspex does today and nothing more. The functions come
from the catalogue of built-in functions, set against the names in Microsoft's reference; the syntax comes from
ScriptDom's own node types and operators, so nothing is left out by being forgotten; and what haruspex says of each is
found by running an example of it ([how](../tests/coverage/README.md)). An unknown is never a guess: where haruspex can't
type something, it claims nothing about it, and the unknown's reason links to what it means and what to do.

## In numbers

| What | Count |
|---|---:|
| Built-in functions the reference documents | 340 |
| In the catalogue | 87 |
| Not in it, and unknown where they are called | 251 |
| Not in it, and read without an unknown, as a condition that proves nothing | 2 |
| Constructs ScriptDom parses | 567 |
| Modelled, wholly or in part | 151 |
| Read, changing no result | 29 |
| Unknown | 325 |
| Not in a procedure's body, or never parsed from one | 40 |
| Parts of another construct | 22 |

## Built-in functions

By the categories of Microsoft's T-SQL reference, read on 15 Nov 2026 (the list, with where it came from:
[sql-server-2025-functions.txt](../tests/coverage/sql-server-2025-functions.txt)). A function in the catalogue has a row
for each form it is called in, with its stable code, the type it gives, the reasons it may be NULL besides its
arguments' ([what each means](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#null-reasons-and-the-constructs-that-give-them)),
and the tests that observed it on SQL Server. Any other is what haruspex gives for a call of it.

## Statements, queries and expressions

Each construct as ScriptDom names it. What a modelled construct gives is explained in the section of [the inference's reference](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md) its claim links.

### Statements that return or write rows

| Syntax | Node | Claim | What it gives |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SELECT` | `SelectStatement` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#result-sets-are-positional) | Each SELECT without INTO returns a result set, typed column by column; SELECT … INTO a temporary table creates it. |
| `INSERT` | `InsertStatement` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#dml) | Writes rows, typed for a temporary table or variable it writes and for its OUTPUT; INSERT … EXEC runs the procedure into the table. |
| `UPDATE` | `UpdateStatement` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#dml) | Changes rows; a column it sets in a temporary table or variable takes the new value's type too. |
| `DELETE` | `DeleteStatement` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#dml) | Removes rows, which changes no column's type. |
| `MERGE` | `MergeStatement` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#dml) | Each WHEN clause is the insert, update or delete it holds. |
| `SET c = x in UPDATE` | `AssignmentSetClause` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#dml) | The column, in a temporary table or variable, takes the value's type too. |
| `SET c.WRITE( … ) in UPDATE` | `FunctionCallSetClause` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#dml) in part; otherwise unknown, [`unsupported-statement`](diagnostics/HAR2001.md) | Read in an UPDATE of a permanent table, which changes no column's type; on a temporary table or variable, whose column it changes, not modelled yet. |
| `TRUNCATE TABLE` | `TruncateTableStatement` | read, changing no result | Removes every row and fires no trigger. |
| `EXECUTE` | `ExecuteStatement` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#calls) in part; otherwise unknown, `dynamic-sql` | A call of a procedure in the project returns what it returns, unless WITH RESULT SETS changes it (below); a string of dynamic SQL can't be read, so the results after it can't be listed. |
| `BULK INSERT` | `BulkInsertStatement` | unknown, [`unsupported-statement`](diagnostics/HAR2001.md) | Not modelled. |
| `INSERT BULK` | `InsertBulkStatement` | unknown, [`unsupported-statement`](diagnostics/HAR2001.md) | Not modelled. |
| `READTEXT` | `ReadTextStatement` | unknown, [`unsupported-statement`](diagnostics/HAR2001.md) | Not modelled. |
| `WRITETEXT` | `WriteTextStatement` | unknown, [`unsupported-statement`](diagnostics/HAR2001.md) | Not modelled. |
| `UPDATETEXT` | `UpdateTextStatement` | unknown, [`unsupported-statement`](diagnostics/HAR2001.md) | Not modelled. |
| `COPY INTO` | `CopyStatement` | unknown, [`unsupported-statement`](diagnostics/HAR2001.md) | Not modelled. |
| `RECEIVE` | `ReceiveStatement` | unknown, [`unsupported-statement`](diagnostics/HAR2001.md) | Not modelled. |

### Calls

| Syntax | Node | Claim | What it gives |
|---|---|---|---|
| `EXEC procedure` | `ExecutableProcedureReference` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#calls) | The procedure called, whose result sets arrive where it is called. |
| `EXEC ( 'string' )` | `ExecutableStringList` | unknown, `dynamic-sql` | Dynamic SQL, which can't be read, so the results after it can't be listed. |
| `EXEC … WITH RECOMPILE` | `ExecuteOption` | read, changing no result | Changes no result. |
| `EXEC … WITH RESULT SETS` | `ResultSetsExecuteOption` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#calls) in part; otherwise unknown, [`unsupported-statement`](diagnostics/HAR2001.md) | UNDEFINED is as no clause; declared result sets or NONE aren't modelled, so the results after the call are unknown. |
| `RESULT SETS (( columns ))` | `InlineResultSetDefinition` | unknown, [`unsupported-statement`](diagnostics/HAR2001.md) | Not modelled yet: the declared columns rename the callee's and convert its values. |
| `RESULT SETS ( AS OBJECT … )` | `SchemaObjectResultSetDefinition` | unknown, [`unsupported-statement`](diagnostics/HAR2001.md) | Not modelled yet. |
| `RESULT SETS ( AS FOR XML )` | `ResultSetDefinition` | unknown, [`unsupported-statement`](diagnostics/HAR2001.md) | Not modelled yet. |

### Statements that steer the flow

| Syntax | Node | Claim | What it gives |
|---|---|---|---|
| `BEGIN … END` | `BeginEndBlockStatement` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#the-state) | Its statements in order. |
| `BEGIN ATOMIC … END` | `BeginEndAtomicBlockStatement` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#the-state) | As BEGIN … END: its statements in order. |
| `IF … ELSE` | `IfStatement` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#joins-where-paths-meet) | Each branch is walked from the state before it, and where they meet their states are joined. |
| `WHILE` | `WhileStatement` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#joins-where-paths-meet) | Its body is walked until another pass changes nothing; a loop that may return result sets makes them vary. |
| `BREAK` | `BreakStatement` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#joins-where-paths-meet) | Leaves the loop, joining its state with the loop's end. |
| `CONTINUE` | `ContinueStatement` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#joins-where-paths-meet) | Goes back to the loop's head, joining its state there. |
| `RETURN` | `ReturnStatement` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#the-state) | Ends the procedure; its result sets are those before it. |
| `BEGIN TRY … BEGIN CATCH` | `TryCatchStatement` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#the-state) | CATCH is reached from the state before any statement of TRY that may fail. |
| `THROW` | `ThrowStatement` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#the-state) | Ends the call, or reaches CATCH. |
| `RAISERROR` | `RaiseErrorStatement` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#the-state) | Of severity 11 or more it ends the call, or reaches CATCH; below that it is a message. |
| `RAISERROR number 'text'` | `RaiseErrorLegacyStatement` | not in a procedure's body | The form SQL Server 2000 had, which the parser for compatibility level 170 refuses. |
| `GOTO` | `GoToStatement` | unknown, [`unsupported-statement`](diagnostics/HAR2001.md) | Not modelled: a jump the walker doesn't follow, so the result sets after it can't be listed. |
| `label:` | `LabelStatement` | unknown, [`unsupported-statement`](diagnostics/HAR2001.md) | Not modelled, as GOTO isn't. |
| `WAITFOR` | `WaitForStatement` | unknown, [`unsupported-statement`](diagnostics/HAR2001.md) | Not modelled. |

### Statements that hold state

| Syntax | Node | Claim | What it gives |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DECLARE @v` | `DeclareVariableStatement` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#the-state) | Declares the variable with its type, holding its initial value or NULL. |
| `SET @v = …` | `SetVariableStatement` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#the-state) in part; otherwise unknown, [`unsupported-statement`](diagnostics/HAR2001.md) | Assigns the value, converted to the variable's type; a variable of a CLR type set by a method call isn't read. |
| `DECLARE @t TABLE` | `DeclareTableVariableStatement` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#the-state) | Declares the table variable with its columns. |
| `DECLARE … CURSOR` | `DeclareCursorStatement` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#cursors) | Declares the cursor, whose FETCH reads its query's columns. |
| `the cursor's options and query` | `CursorDefinition` | part of `DeclareCursorStatement` |  |
| `NEXT, PRIOR, FIRST, … in FETCH` | `FetchType` | part of `FetchCursorStatement` |  |
| `OPEN` | `OpenCursorStatement` | read, changing no result | Returns nothing. |
| `FETCH` | `FetchCursorStatement` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#cursors) | FETCH … INTO sets its variables to the cursor's columns; FETCH without INTO returns one row of them. |
| `CLOSE` | `CloseCursorStatement` | read, changing no result | Returns nothing. |
| `DEALLOCATE` | `DeallocateCursorStatement` | read, changing no result | Returns nothing. |
| `CREATE TABLE` | `CreateTableStatement` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#a-temporary-tables-columns) in part; otherwise unknown, [`unsupported-statement`](diagnostics/HAR2001.md) | A temporary table is created with its columns; a permanent one isn't modelled. |
| `DROP TABLE` | `DropTableStatement` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#a-temporary-tables-columns) in part; otherwise unknown, [`unsupported-statement`](diagnostics/HAR2001.md) | Dropping temporary tables removes them; dropping a permanent one isn't modelled. |
| `ALTER TABLE … ADD` | `AlterTableAddTableElementStatement` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#a-temporary-tables-columns) in part; otherwise unknown, [`unsupported-statement`](diagnostics/HAR2001.md) | A column added to a temporary table joins its columns; altering a permanent table isn't modelled. |
| `ALTER TABLE … ALTER COLUMN` | `AlterTableAlterColumnStatement` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#a-temporary-tables-columns) in part; otherwise unknown, [`unsupported-statement`](diagnostics/HAR2001.md) | A temporary table's column takes its new type; a permanent one isn't modelled. |
| `ALTER TABLE … DROP` | `AlterTableDropTableElementStatement` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#a-temporary-tables-columns) in part; otherwise unknown, [`unsupported-statement`](diagnostics/HAR2001.md) | A column dropped from a temporary table leaves it; a permanent table isn't modelled. |
| `CREATE INDEX` | `CreateIndexStatement` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#a-temporary-tables-columns) in part; otherwise unknown, [`unsupported-statement`](diagnostics/HAR2001.md) | An index on a temporary table changes nothing; one on a permanent table isn't modelled. |
| `INDEX in CREATE TABLE` | `IndexDefinition` | part of `CreateTableStatement` |  |

| Syntax | Node | Claim | What it gives |
|---|---|---|---|

| `SET STATISTICS` | `SetStatisticsStatement` | unknown, [`unsupported-statement`](diagnostics/HAR2001.md) | Not modelled. |
| `SET OFFSETS` | `SetOffsetsStatement` | unknown, [`unsupported-statement`](diagnostics/HAR2001.md) | Not modelled. |
| `SET ERRLVL` | `SetErrorLevelStatement` | unknown, [`unsupported-statement`](diagnostics/HAR2001.md) | Not modelled. |
| `EXECUTE AS` | `ExecuteAsStatement` | unknown, [`unsupported-statement`](diagnostics/HAR2001.md) | Not modelled: it changes whose schema a one-part name resolves in. |

| `SETUSER` | `SetUserStatement` | unknown, [`unsupported-statement`](diagnostics/HAR2001.md) | Not modelled. |
| `USE` | `UseStatement` | unknown, [`unsupported-statement`](diagnostics/HAR2001.md) | Not modelled. |
| `DBCC` | `DbccStatement` | unknown, [`unsupported-statement`](diagnostics/HAR2001.md) | Not modelled. |
| `CHECKPOINT` | `CheckpointStatement` | unknown, [`unsupported-statement`](diagnostics/HAR2001.md) | Not modelled. |
| `UPDATE STATISTICS` | `UpdateStatisticsStatement` | unknown, [`unsupported-statement`](diagnostics/HAR2001.md) | Not modelled. |
| `KILL` | `KillStatement` | unknown, [`unsupported-statement`](diagnostics/HAR2001.md) | Not modelled. |
| `SHUTDOWN` | `ShutdownStatement` | unknown, [`unsupported-statement`](diagnostics/HAR2001.md) | Not modelled. |
| `LINENO` | `LineNoStatement` | unknown, [`unsupported-statement`](diagnostics/HAR2001.md) | Not modelled. |

### Statements a procedure's body can't hold

| Syntax | Node | Claim | What it gives |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CREATE PROCEDURE` | `CreateProcedureStatement` | not in a procedure's body | Must be the only statement in its batch. |
| `ALTER PROCEDURE` | `AlterProcedureStatement` | not in a procedure's body | Must be the only statement in its batch. |
| `CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE` | `CreateOrAlterProcedureStatement` | not in a procedure's body | Must be the only statement in its batch. |
| `CREATE FUNCTION` | `CreateFunctionStatement` | not in a procedure's body | Must be the only statement in its batch. |
| `ALTER FUNCTION` | `AlterFunctionStatement` | not in a procedure's body | Must be the only statement in its batch. |
| `CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION` | `CreateOrAlterFunctionStatement` | not in a procedure's body | Must be the only statement in its batch. |
| `CREATE VIEW` | `CreateViewStatement` | not in a procedure's body | Must be the only statement in its batch. |
| `ALTER VIEW` | `AlterViewStatement` | not in a procedure's body | Must be the only statement in its batch. |
| `CREATE OR ALTER VIEW` | `CreateOrAlterViewStatement` | not in a procedure's body | Must be the only statement in its batch. |
| `CREATE TRIGGER` | `CreateTriggerStatement` | not in a procedure's body | Must be the only statement in its batch. |
| `ALTER TRIGGER` | `AlterTriggerStatement` | not in a procedure's body | Must be the only statement in its batch. |
| `CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER` | `CreateOrAlterTriggerStatement` | not in a procedure's body | Must be the only statement in its batch. |
| `CREATE SCHEMA` | `CreateSchemaStatement` | not in a procedure's body | Must be the only statement in its batch. |
| `CREATE DEFAULT` | `CreateDefaultStatement` | not in a procedure's body | Must be the only statement in its batch. |
| `CREATE RULE` | `CreateRuleStatement` | not in a procedure's body | Must be the only statement in its batch. |

### Queries

| Syntax | Node | Claim | What it gives |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SELECT … FROM …` | `QuerySpecification` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#result-sets-are-positional) | Its columns, typed one by one, over the rows its sources and filters give. |
| `UNION, EXCEPT, INTERSECT` | `BinaryQueryExpression` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#set-operations) | Columns are combined by position, each of the type of highest precedence. |
| `( query )` | `QueryParenthesisExpression` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#set-operations) | The query inside. |
| `UNION [ALL]` | `BinaryQueryExpressionType.Union` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#set-operations) | Each column's type is that of highest precedence; NULL where either side is. |
| `EXCEPT` | `BinaryQueryExpressionType.Except` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#set-operations) | The left side's rows, so its columns. |
| `INTERSECT` | `BinaryQueryExpressionType.Intersect` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#set-operations) | Rows both sides hold. |
| `column or expression in SELECT` | `SelectScalarExpression` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#result-sets-are-positional) | A column of the result, named by its alias or the column it reads. |
| `* and t.*` | `SelectStarExpression` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#select-) | Expanded into the columns of the tables the project defines. |
| `SELECT @v = …` | `SelectSetVariable` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#the-state) | Sets the variable, from the last row read or left as it was over no rows; returns nothing. |
| `WITH` | `WithCtesAndXmlNamespaces` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#ctes) | The common table expressions a query reads. |
| `name AS ( query )` | `CommonTableExpression` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#ctes) | A named query, read as a table; a recursive one has its anchor's types, and its nullability is found by reading its recursive members until nothing changes. |
| `WITH XMLNAMESPACES` | `XmlNamespaces` | unknown, [`unsupported-query`](diagnostics/HAR2004.md) | Not modelled. |
| `FROM` | `FromClause` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#result-sets-are-positional) | Its sources, joined. |
| `WHERE` | `WhereClause` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#refinement) | Filters rows, and what it proves about a column (such as IS NOT NULL) holds after it. |
| `GROUP BY` | `GroupByClause` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#aggregates-and-scalar-subqueries) | One row per group. |
| `HAVING` | `HavingClause` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#refinement) | Filters groups. |
| `FOR SYSTEM_TIME` | `TemporalClause` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#how-many-rows-cardinalitycs) | The table's columns, its hidden period columns left out of *; read at other than AS OF, its rows may repeat a key, so key claims are dropped. |
| `x ASC, x DESC` | `ExpressionWithSortOrder` | part of `OrderByClause` |  |
| `UNBOUNDED PRECEDING, n PRECEDING, …` | `WindowDelimiter` | part of `WindowFrameClause` |  |
| `ORDER BY` | `OrderByClause` | read, changing no result | Orders rows, which changes no column. |
| `TOP` | `TopRowFilter` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#how-many-rows-cardinalitycs) | Limits the rows, which changes no column; TOP (1) returns at most one. |
| `OFFSET … FETCH` | `OffsetClause` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#how-many-rows-cardinalitycs) | Skips and limits rows, which changes no column. |
| `OVER` | `OverClause` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#window-functions) | Makes a function a window function. |
| `ROWS or RANGE frame` | `WindowFrameClause` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#window-functions) | A frame that may leave out the current row may be empty, so an aggregate over it may be NULL. |
| `WINDOW` | `WindowClause` | unknown, [`unsupported-expression`](diagnostics/HAR2005.md) | Not modelled: a function over a named window is unknown. |
| `name AS ( window )` | `WindowDefinition` | part of `WindowClause` |  |
| `WITHIN GROUP` | `WithinGroupClause` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#window-functions) | The order PERCENTILE_CONT, PERCENTILE_DISC and STRING_AGG read. |
| `TABLESAMPLE` | `TableSampleClause` | read, changing no result | Returns some of the table's rows, which changes no column. |
| `OUTPUT` | `OutputClause` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#output) | Returns the rows written, typed from inserted and deleted. |
| `OUTPUT … INTO` | `OutputIntoClause` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#output) | Writes the rows written into a table, returning nothing. |

| `REGEXP_LIKE` | `RegexpLikePredicate` | read, changing no result | Filters rows; proves nothing about a column. |
| `TSEQUAL` | `TSEqualCall` | read, changing no result | Filters rows; proves nothing about a column. |
| `UPDATE( column )` | `UpdateCall` | read, changing no result | In a trigger, whether a column was written; proves nothing about a column. |
| `MATCH` | `GraphMatchPredicate` | read, changing no result | Filters rows of graph tables; proves nothing about a column. |
| `a-(edge)->b` | `GraphMatchExpression` | part of `GraphMatchPredicate` |  |
| `a-(e)->b-(f)->c` | `GraphMatchCompositeExpression` | part of `GraphMatchPredicate` |  |
| `a node in MATCH` | `GraphMatchNodeExpression` | part of `GraphMatchPredicate` |  |
| `LAST_NODE( … ) = LAST_NODE( … )` | `GraphMatchLastNodePredicate` | part of `GraphMatchPredicate` |  |
| `SHORTEST_PATH( … )` | `GraphMatchRecursivePredicate` | part of `GraphMatchPredicate` |  |
| `{1,3} and + in SHORTEST_PATH` | `GraphRecursiveMatchQuantifier` | part of `GraphMatchPredicate` |  |
|  | `BooleanExpressionSnippet` | never parsed from a body | Built by code that holds SQL as text, never by the parser. |
| `an event's predicate` | `EventDeclarationCompareFunctionParameter` | never parsed from a body | Part of an event session's definition, never of a body. |

### Comparisons and logical operators

| Syntax | Node | Claim | What it gives |
|---|---|---|---|
| `=` | `BooleanComparisonType.Equals` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#which-conditions-prove-a-column-non-null) | With the column as an operand, proves it non-null where it holds. |
| `<>` | `BooleanComparisonType.NotEqualToBrackets` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#which-conditions-prove-a-column-non-null) | With the column as an operand, proves it non-null where it holds. |
| `!=` | `BooleanComparisonType.NotEqualToExclamation` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#which-conditions-prove-a-column-non-null) | With the column as an operand, proves it non-null where it holds. |
| `>` | `BooleanComparisonType.GreaterThan` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#which-conditions-prove-a-column-non-null) | With the column as an operand, proves it non-null where it holds. |
| `<` | `BooleanComparisonType.LessThan` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#which-conditions-prove-a-column-non-null) | With the column as an operand, proves it non-null where it holds. |
| `>=` | `BooleanComparisonType.GreaterThanOrEqualTo` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#which-conditions-prove-a-column-non-null) | With the column as an operand, proves it non-null where it holds. |
| `<=` | `BooleanComparisonType.LessThanOrEqualTo` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#which-conditions-prove-a-column-non-null) | With the column as an operand, proves it non-null where it holds. |
| `!<` | `BooleanComparisonType.NotLessThan` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#which-conditions-prove-a-column-non-null) | With the column as an operand, proves it non-null where it holds. |
| `!>` | `BooleanComparisonType.NotGreaterThan` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#which-conditions-prove-a-column-non-null) | With the column as an operand, proves it non-null where it holds. |
| `IS DISTINCT FROM` | `BooleanComparisonType.IsDistinctFrom` | never parsed from a body | The parser writes IS DISTINCT FROM as a DistinctPredicate, not a comparison of this kind. |
| `IS NOT DISTINCT FROM` | `BooleanComparisonType.IsNotDistinctFrom` | never parsed from a body | The parser writes IS NOT DISTINCT FROM as a DistinctPredicate, not a comparison of this kind. |
| `NOT LIKE` | `BooleanComparisonType.NotLike` | never parsed from a body | The parser writes NOT LIKE as a LikePredicate, not a comparison of this kind. |
| `*=` | `BooleanComparisonType.LeftOuterJoin` | not in a procedure's body | The outer join SQL Server 2000 wrote in WHERE, refused since. |
| `=*` | `BooleanComparisonType.RightOuterJoin` | not in a procedure's body | As *=. |
| `AND` | `BooleanBinaryExpressionType.And` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#which-conditions-prove-a-column-non-null) | Proves what either side proves. |
| `OR` | `BooleanBinaryExpressionType.Or` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#which-conditions-prove-a-column-non-null) | Proves what both sides prove. |
| `BETWEEN` | `BooleanTernaryExpressionType.Between` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#which-conditions-prove-a-column-non-null) | Proves the column non-null where it holds. |
| `NOT BETWEEN` | `BooleanTernaryExpressionType.NotBetween` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#which-conditions-prove-a-column-non-null) | Proves the column non-null where it holds. |
| `ALL` | `SubqueryComparisonPredicateType.All` | read, changing no result | Proves nothing about a column. |
| `ANY, SOME` | `SubqueryComparisonPredicateType.Any` | read, changing no result | Proves nothing about a column. |
|  | `SubqueryComparisonPredicateType.None` | never parsed from a body | The parser writes a comparison with a subquery's value as a comparison, so a SubqueryComparisonPredicate is always ALL or ANY. |

### Hints

| Syntax | Node | Claim | What it gives |
|---|---|---|---|
| `WITH ( NOLOCK ), …` | `TableHint` | [modelled](../src/Haruspex.SqlServer.Inference/README.md#how-many-rows-cardinalitycs) | Changes no column; NOLOCK reads uncommitted rows, so key claims are dropped. |
| `WITH ( SPATIAL_WINDOW_MAX_CELLS = … )` | `LiteralTableHint` | read, changing no result | Changes no result. |
| `WITH ( INDEX ( … ) ), WITH ( INDEX = … )` | `IndexTableHint` | read, changing no result | Changes no result. |
| `WITH ( FORCESEEK ( … ) )` | `ForceSeekTableHint` | read, changing no result | Changes no result. |
| `OPTION ( RECOMPILE ), …` | `OptimizerHint` | read, changing no result | Changes no result. |
| `OPTION ( MAXDOP 1 ), …` | `LiteralOptimizerHint` | read, changing no result | Changes no result. |
| `OPTION ( OPTIMIZE FOR … )` | `OptimizeForOptimizerHint` | read, changing no result | Changes no result. |
| `OPTION ( TABLE HINT … )` | `TableHintsOptimizerHint` | read, changing no result | Changes no result. |
| `OPTION ( USE HINT … )` | `UseHintList` | read, changing no result | Changes no result. |
